full_judgment:
Mohammad Abdur Rouf, J: The pre-emptee-petitioner has sought for leave to appeal by this petition from the judgment and order dated 8.4.96 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division making the rule issued in Civil Revision No. 3541 of 1993 absolute and reversing thereby the judgment and order passed by the learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Sylhet in Misc. Appeal No. 159 of 1982 reversing those dated 30.8.82 passed in Misc. (pre-emption) case No. 27 of 1980 by the learned Munsif, Additional Court, Sadar, Sylhet allowing pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. The original pre-emptor as a contiguous owner sought for pre-empting the land sold on 24.7.76 alleging 19.11.78 to be the date of his knowledge of the sale. The pre-emptor had the knowledge of sale from the very beginning of the sale and the case is hopelessly barred by limitation. 

 4. Mr. Md. Fazlul Karim, learned Advocate appearing for the pre-emptee-petitioner submits that the case for pre-emption having not been filed within the statutory period of limitation, provided in Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act and the lower appellate court on consideration of the evidence on record having rightly held that the case was barred by limitation, the learned Judge of the High Court Division committed an error of law in interfering with such finding of fact in exercise of the revisional jurisdiction under Section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
